name: Drift Protocol

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: In April 2026 a 2-of-5 multisig with no delay, which held Drift's admin key, was used to reassign it to an attacker (press reports $285M drained). The upgrade multisig is now 4-of-7 with a 1-hour delay, still short of strong.
narrative.detail: The repo verified on chain the two transactions on 2026-04-01 that used the old multisig to reassign Drift's admin key. The roughly 31 withdrawals were not re-derived. That multisig also had a non-default config_authority, not traced further. Retroactive score of that setup: 32. Now the upgrade multisig is 4-of-7 (6 can vote), 1-hour delay, autonomous. The DAO realm authority is self-governed: token vote with a 2% yes threshold, 1-day hold-up, 4-day voting, plus a 5-seat council that can only veto. The oracle sub-score rests on one Switchboard-fed market (AI16Z), not every market.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData 7dLgmt… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig 7qipzLR9j1JcvdxE1XJEFgvoyFmgBpgw5hMdHBMPcJtM
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 4-of-7, 6 can vote of 7 plain keys; delay: 1 h Squads time lock
